text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
—The date for the tour of the URA 
headquarters has been set. I will send 
over the list of questions shortly, so 
please review them.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I see. ...You really are remarkably 
capable. If you were the student council 
president, this academy would be in safe 
hands.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
No... far from it. Every day is a struggle 
against my own short-sightedness.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I see. Never satisfied with the status 
quo, always aiming higher... That is so 
like you.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Still, sometimes accepting an objective 
evaluation is crucial. If only to know 
accurately where you currently stand.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
With all due respect... until I achieve my 
ideal, I cannot accept myself. It is this 
very resolve that permits me to lead by 
example.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
No, I'm truly moved. Rudolf, you have 
grown into a truly splendid person.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
If you still cannot bring yourself to 
acknowledge your own worth, then I shall 
shower you with eloquent and boundless 
praise.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"Good work. You are truly wonderful, 
Rudolf. ...You're doing so well, honestly. 
You are my pride."

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
You are fine just the way you are right 
now. Let me take care of you— to make up 
for all the time we couldn't meet.
